title: Cloud Services for Businesses
description: Migrate to a cloud solution tailored to your business reality. Victrix accelerates and simplifies your transition with customized cloud services.

sections.title: Cloud Services for Businesses
sections.lead: To improve your teams' responsiveness, the flexibility of your infrastructure, and the profitability of your technologies, cloud computing is the first solution to consider. Modernize your IT with a personalized approach based on acceleration, from project start-up to completion.

sections.title: Cloud Solutions and Services
sections.intro: Our cloud services are designed to meet the unique challenges of your organization — from selecting your cloud solution to migrating workloads and continuously optimizing your cloud environment.

featured.title: A planned migration strategy
featured.text: A planned migration strategy ensures a smooth transition with minimal impact on your environment. Our mission: guarantee your operational excellence using best practices for compliance, data security, and performance — the Well Architected Framework (WAF) and Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) guide all your cloud migration projects.

aside.title: Strategic consulting
aside.text: Take advantage of our expertise in strategic consulting to ensure the success of all your digital transformation projects.

sections.title: Our Cloud Solutions
paragraphs: From hosting sensitive files and data to deploying a customized enterprise cloud server, Victrix is here for you. Our cloud computing experts offer trusted cloud solutions to modernize and grow your business.

Victrix accelerates your migration to Azure. Our methodology, based on the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework, enables your organization to take the first steps in migrating your applications and servers — with secure data storage in Azure and all of Microsoft's innovative features to optimize your productivity and workspace. Learn about migrating to Azure

Leverage the AWS Enterprise platform with Victrix. Drawing on our expertise in Amazon EC2 (IaaS), AWS Elastic Beanstalk (PaaS), and AWS services (SaaS), we can ensure efficient migration of applications to a service model that promotes scalability and simplifies management. Learn about migrating to AWS

sections.sectionTitle: Our Acceleration Strategy: IaaS — SaaS — PaaS Services
sections.intro: Continuous integration and delivery: identification of opportunities (planning, vision, costing), proof of concept (experimentation and validation), then acceleration of the migration to the cloud.

items.title: Project Kick-Off
items.text: Kick-off meeting: understanding the project, implementation schedule and stakeholder participation, technical and other prerequisites, roles required by workshop and committee.

items.title: Definition
items.text: Identification, definition, and prioritization of migration opportunities; infrastructure analysis.

items.title: Feasibility
items.text: Preparation of the opportunity and feasibility analysis: organizational context, understanding of technological and business challenges, IT asset inventory, mapping of interdependencies, and license analysis.

items.title: Concept
items.text: Proof of concept: architecture and deployment strategy, implementation, proof of concept realization, and documentation.

items.title: Scaling
items.text: Analysis and proposal of preferred scaling options, then scaling systems.

items.title: Iterations
items.text: Acceleration in iterative mode: analysis of needs, opportunities, and mapping; implementation (deployment, security, and governance); migration (mapping, classification, migration, and testing); optimization and governance.

sections.body: Leverage our expertise for your AWS or Azure migration projects to benefit from secure, flexible, and accessible cloud storage through our multi-cloud practice.
